content_record.title: Nanomedicine that targets ATP synthase reverses bone aging in mice
content_record.editorial_body: A new class of energy-metabolism-engaged nanomedicines (EM-eNMs) infiltrates mitochondria, triggers fission and mitophagy, and restores stemness in aged bone marrow cells, reversing osteoporotic bone loss in mice. Three things to remember - EM-eNMs bind ATP synthase, inducing DRP1-mediated mitochondrial fission. - Systemic delivery selectively targets bone, reversing osteoporosis in aged mice. - Mechanism parallels caloric restriction, activating mitophagy to clear damaged mitochondria. Source This signal is based on An energy metabolism-engaged nanomedicine maintains mitochondrial homeostasis to alleviate cellular ageing. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Preclinical study in mice; human efficacy and safety unproven.
